label: Warehouse C - GeneXus Wizard Defaults
description: Full literal scale from the original GeneXus WmsOffice.NewStorageStructureStep1/Step2 wizard (the Acesso login panel's "Wisard" button): 12 Recebimento baias (60 pos each), 12 Expedicao baias (50 pos each), 1 Pre-Picking rua (200 pos), 1 Avarias rua (80 pos), and 11 Armazenagem corredores (A-J, T) with per-corredor rua/andar/posicao counts hardcoded in NewStorageStructureStep2's GridSection.Load -- 290 ruas, 6268 total storage positions.
